sentence: This project develops methods that make causal conclusions from complex data using machine learning explainable and statistically sound.
This project develops a method for designing human-machine interfaces that minimizes human error caused by mode confusion.
This project develops a way for aerial robots to manipulate and transport flexible objects such as cables, rods and plastic sheets.
This project acquires a sequencing platform that combines traditional sequencing with single-cell and multi-omics capabilities.
This project creates teaching units that explain how AI systems can fail or be attacked.
This project studies how iron-starved bacteria defend themselves against nitric oxide.
This project develops a framework that helps autonomous driving systems adapt to changing conditions and keep predictable timing.
This project advances cybersecurity education through research.
This project studies surfactant proteins that coat protein-rich droplets in cells and uses them to engineer enzyme materials.
This project asks whether spatial patterns of brain activity, such as waves, are coordinated across brain regions in mice.
This project develops a framework to integrate quantum information science with terahertz sensing and communication.
This project builds miniaturized chemical computing devices that use much less energy than current systems.
This project uses gene editing to delete many genes from Arabidopsis thaliana and build a platform for engineering plants.
This project combines photonic and electronic chiplets so AI methods can sense the entire radio frequency spectrum in real time.
This project studies how principal component analysis learns from data when samples from different sources have different noise.
